scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @app/api db:generate && concurrently -k "pnpm --filter @app/api dev" "pnpm --filter @app/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @app/api db:generate && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @app/api db:generate && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
